source_property.numeric_property_id: Runtime Shader.PropertyToID result; no fabricated process-specific integer.

registration.shader_condition: Any non-null Renderer.GetSharedMaterialArray element whose material.shader equals the original _regionMapShader.
registration.texture_condition: Own cached MeshRenderer, _regionMapShader and minimapOutlineTex must be non-null.
registration.update: GetPropertyBlock(existing renderer-wide block) -> SetTexture(_BuildingTex, source minimapOutlineTex) -> SetPropertyBlock(block) without materialIndex.
registration.scope: All material slots/passes on this Renderer. The shader equality check controls whether the renderer-wide update occurs, not which slots receive a block.

operations: If cached renderer is valid: SetPropertyBlock(null) without materialIndex
disable.effect: Clear the renderer-wide property block, not only its _BuildingTex entry.

policy: Exact installed metadata literal and serialized source manager/renderer/material/texture identities. Runtime enabled/active state still controls OnEnable; no game-state visibility or process-specific numeric propertyID is invented.
